exercise.name: Cable Pullover
library_steps: Clip a rope to the high cable, step back and lean forward a little.
Hold the rope up in front of your head with arms nearly straight.
Pull the rope down in an arc to your thighs, then return slowly.
exercise.one_line_summary: Facing a high pulley, leaning ~20 deg forward with a rope held in both hands; nearly straight arms sweep from up in front of the head down in an arc to the thighs. Lats do the work, the triceps (long head) helps.

setup.target: High (~2 m), athlete about a metre back.
Leaning ~20 deg forward from the hips, back flat.

muscles.emg: Latissimus activity in the pullover depends on the shoulder angle and where the load pulls from (S1, S2); the cable from above loads shoulder extension through the range the lats work in (S2).
muscles.role: Pull the arm down and back; library primary.
muscles.surface: Side of the back under the arm.

muscles.emg: not measured (two-joint long head extends the shoulder)
muscles.role: Helps pull the arm down; library secondary.

muscles.emg: Pectoralis was more active than the lats in the LYING barbell pullover (S1).
muscles.role: Helps at the top of the arc; not lit (library does not list it).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Turns the pullover into a pushdown.

mistakes.why_it_matters: Library: lean a little, back flat.

sources.citation: Marchetti PH, Uchida MC. 2011. Effects of the pullover exercise on the pectoralis major and latissimus dorsi muscles as evaluated by EMG. J Appl Biomech 27(4):380-384.
sources.what_it_gave: Lying barbell pullover: pectoralis major more active than latissimus dorsi; activity depends on the external force lever arm (where the load pulls from).

sources.citation: Teixeira LFM, Gomes WA, da Silva JJ, Magalhaes RA, Marchetti PH. 2022. Differences between pullover and pulldown exercises on maximal isometric force and myoelectric activity in recreationally-trained men. Int J Exerc Sci 15(4):797-807.
sources.what_it_gave: Pullover vs pulldown at five shoulder angles: latissimus dorsi, pectoralis major and posterior deltoid activity depends on the shoulder angle.

clip_check.check: Start: straight arms up in front of the head
Both fists closed on the rope; rope to the high pulley in front
